input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII is the only cap in the Agreement (no other "aggregate liability" or "exceed" language exists). It caps Licensor alone at one half of amounts paid, leaving Licensee's liability wholly uncapped — and Licensee additionally bears a broad indemnity in Article XII. That is walk-away territory on two counts (one-sided cap; Vendor cap effectively below 6 months' fees) and there are no carve-outs for indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence or willful misconduct (the gross negligence/willful misconduct reference in Article II is an exception to Licensee's assumption of risk, not a cap carve-out). We target the fallback: cap made mutual at 12 months' fees plus the four fallback carve-outs, in two surgical edits. We deliberately did not make the Article XIII(a) consequential-damages waiver mutual (it currently protects only Licensor, so Customer benefits from the asymmetry) and note, without redlining, that Licensor's blanket exclusion of IP-infringement liability in (a) and the absence of a USD 1,000,000 floor fall short of our preferred position.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at 12 months' fees and place indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need a mutual cap: as drafted only Licensor is capped (at one half of amounts paid) while Licensee's liability is unlimited, which is below our walk-away floor. We have moved to our fallback position of a mutual cap of 12 months' fees and confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

ops.text: THE CAP IN SECTION (b) SHALL NOT APPLY TO, AND EACH PARTY'S LIABILITY SHALL BE UNCAPPED FOR, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
